field_definitions.expected_shell_environment_key_count: Predicted shell map without fixed SIQ transport fields; 61/64/64 for r3/r4/r5.
field_definitions.environment_difference_expected_key_coun: Actual comparison map includes fixed SIQ transport fields and excludes the dynamic session identifier; r3 is 71.
field_definitions.frozen_file_count: Number of entries in the private freeze manifest; excludes the manifest itself, which has a separate source-index row.
field_definitions.installed_role_count: Pinned functional input roles; several roles may reference the same physical file.

scope: one real Windows device, synthetic provider, r5 optional LSP disabled; no SIQ B or full platform acceptance
